_G.InstantWin = true
local InstantWin
InstantWin = hookmetamethod(game,"__namecall",function(self,...)
    local args = {...}

            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remote.Event.Game:FindFirstChild("[C-S]PlayerEnd"):FireServer(true,1)
            args[1] = false
        end
    end
    return InstantWin(self,...)
end)
